hypothesis: Diagnostic, not a fix: blinds (11 slats per floor) and curtain edges alias long before the window cells do; replacing both with their means at every distance shows how much of the visible shimmer they carry.

provenance.note: The means are the whole-cell expectations V2-3b wrote down. Over the pane, where these factors are seen, the true curtain mean differs, so brightness shifts and the guard result is not meaningful for this diagnostic.
